sentences.text: The documents do not state a date for existing loan accounts to move to the revised penal charges framework under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025.
The in-force UCB directions only say that penal charges instructions apply to “all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards”.

The only transition timing found for existing loans is in the superseded 2023 circular, which said the switchover shall be ensured on next review or renewal date or six months from the effective date of these instructions, whichever is earlier.

missing.slot: date existing loan accounts must move to revised penal charges framework
